Today 09:41

oskar.berg@vesence.com


Alex,


Attaching our revised term sheet for the Series A. We've held the pre-money at SEK 240m, and three points have moved since the last draft:


- Clause 2.1 — liquidation preference stays at 1× non-participating, as discussed.
- Clause 7.2 — the 15% option pool sits inside the pre-money. We appreciate this is the point you'll want to push on.
- Clause 3.1 — one investor board seat rather than two, with the reserved matters in Schedule 3 unchanged.


We'd like to sign before the end of the month. Happy to take the pool question on a call on Wednesday.


Best,


Clara
